purpose: Marketing hero graphic for the Scriptly PC landing page (site/scriptly-landing.html)
status: design-only draft, not wired into any page
brand_source: assets/BRAND.md (palette) + site/scriptly-landing.html (fonts, existing hero headline/eyebrow copy, app-mock pattern)
copy_source: Reused verbatim from the existing landing-page hero (site/scriptly-landing.html lines ~288-313): headline "Every conversation on your PC, written down.", eyebrow "100% offline · Windows", statusline text. No new marketing copy was invented for this asset.
render_method: Local-only: hand-written HTML/CSS (hero.html) rendered to PNG with headless Chromium via Playwright (device_scale_factor=2), then converted to WebP with Pillow. No generative AI (Bloom or otherwise) was used.
